name: tmc-level-params
description: Level difficulty parameter harness for level designers: from a batch of theme + difficulty tier inputs (five tiers learned from the competitor difficulty labels), generate and check one parameter set per level, print every parameter, and draw the batch difficulty against the competitor.

interface.shortDescription: Generate checked parameters for a batch of theme + tier levels.
interface.longDescription: For level designers, not production. Input a batch of levels, each a theme and a difficulty tier 1-5. Five tiers are learned from the competitor mainline data: a class-balanced logistic model scores how much a level looks like the competitor Hard/ExHard levels from six parameters, and the score quantiles cut the real levels into five equal tiers. For each level the harness draws the joint form, totals, kinds, four-category split, per-kind counts, targets, stacking, moving vehicles and duration from real levels of that tier and checks every rule and that the drawn parameters score inside the tier; the same theme and tier always give the same level. show prints every parameter; overview draws the batch difficulty curve on a 0-100 % competitor ruler with each parameter against its tier range; files are level-params.json/csv/xlsx with one asset list per theme. Items are placeholders (building 1, prop 3). xlsx export needs xlsxwriter; the picture needs matplotlib.
